objects.standing_objects: b in {-1,+1}; mu_{n,b} is Haar probability on O(n) conditioned on determinant b. A_O=((kappa+1)/2) I_n - ((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T). pi_A=N(0,A^{-1}) is the Gaussian with precision A, not covariance A.
objects.actual_single_block: P_b = E_{O~mu_{n,b}}[N(0,A_O^{-1})]. p_O and p_b denote densities of these very laws. Source A2.SS2.p2.1 does not permit arbitrary probability densities to replace them.
objects.actual_multiblock: O_1,...,O_k are independent under the fixed common determinant sign b. A_boldO=diag(A_O1,...,A_Ok,I_{d-kn}); D_b is its induced precision prior. barpi_b=E_{A~D_b}[pi_A]=P_b^{tensor k} tensor N(0,I_{d-kn}), with the residual factor omitted when kn=d.
objects.auxiliary: a=int_{R^n} sqrt(p_+ p_-) dx. barp_b is a density of actual barpi_b. phi_{d-kn} is the standard residual Gaussian density when d-kn>0.

domains.source_parameter_domain: The Section 3 construction fixes kappa>=4, integers 3<=n<=d, and k=floor(d/n), hence k>=1 and 0<=d-kn<n. The direct Ex72 source conclusion is over this domain.
domains.measures_and_spaces: Euclidean R^n and R^d with their Borel sigma algebras and Lebesgue measure; the displayed block-coordinate product space is identified with R^d. TV itself is on a common measurable space.
domains.residual_alias: This packet uses r0:=d-kn only as an explicit local alias; the pinned source writes d-kn. r0>0 has an actual standard Gaussian factor; r0=0 omits it. This r0 is unrelated to the B7 Poisson parameter r.
domains.excluded_from_ex72_domain: No T, epsilon, randomized algorithm, transcript, query bound, hidden-basis spectrum, warm start or expected cost is quantified in the Ex72 amplification conclusion. A generic product lemma may have wider domains but does not itself discharge the actual-law source target.

quantifiers.statement: For every admissible d,n,kappa with k fixed by floor(d/n), construct both signs using the specified conditioned-Haar Gaussian mixtures; the displayed lower bound holds for TV(barpi_+1,barpi_-1).
quantifiers.independence_scope: Independence is conditional on each fixed common sign. This is not independently sampled signs per block and not a tensor power of an unconditional sign mixture.
quantifiers.representative_scope: The asserted law-level conclusion is independent of density representatives. Any use of chosen pointwise nonnegative densities must be shown to represent the same actual laws.

assumptions.SOURCE: n>=3 and kappa>=4 for single-block separation and the section; construction also has n<=d and k=floor(d/n).
assumptions.STANDING: Haar probability/component conditioning, actual precision matrices and Gaussian/mixture/product definitions are the Section 2/3 setting.
assumptions.TYPING: Euclidean Borel spaces, integer dimensions and real parameters; measure and coordinate transport choices that encode the stated objects.
not_new_premises: TV equals half L1 or one minus overlap
assumptions.rule: Each needed fact above is a proof ingredient to discharge internally using genuine parents or elementary mathematics. It cannot be a new public premise of the actual source theorem merely because a producer exists.

conclusion.Ex68: a = int sqrt(p_+ p_-) over R^n.
conclusion.Ex70: barp_b(x_1,...,x_k,z) = product_{j=1}^k p_b(x_j)*phi_{d-kn}(z), in the positive residual case; omit phi and z when kn=d.
conclusion.Ex71: int_{R^d} sqrt(barp_+ barp_-) = a^k, by Tonelli and normalized residual factor or the omission branch.

scopes_senses.TV: TV(P,Q)=sup_{B measurable}|P(B)-Q(B)|=(1/2)*int|p-q| d lambda. For probability densities it also equals 1-int min(p,q). No doubled variation norm may be silently substituted.
scopes_senses.law_vs_density: Both TV terms in Ex69 and Ex72 concern actual probability laws. Density integrals alone must be connected to those laws via a common dominating measure, representatives and the exact TV normalization.
scopes_senses.finite_real_semantics: Integrals and inequalities in the source are finite real quantities. ENNReal/toReal implementations must establish finiteness; Lean totalized real division, integral defaults or square roots cannot substitute for analytic justification.
scopes_senses.coordinate_transport: If implementation works on block products rather than R^d, show the measurable probability-preserving coordinate regrouping and TV transport. Equality of a synthetic product law without identification with the precision-prior average is insufficient.
scopes_senses.residual_cases: The source supplies two sufficient residual cases: kn<d with normalized phi, OR kn=d with factor omitted. These are branches, never jointly required assumptions. A unified zero-dimensional construction is acceptable only if shown equivalent to the source omission.
scopes_senses.statement_status: This is a source-only expectations freeze, not a verdict on any Lean declaration, decoder, audit, publication, source coverage completion or lifecycle state.

constant_dependencies.B7_input: TV(P_+,P_-) >= 1/2*exp(-5*n/sqrt(kappa)) for the actual laws. The sharper B7 rational expression is source material but the Ex72 exponential route consumes this simpler lower bound.
constant_dependencies.affinity_conversion: sqrt(1-t)<=exp(-t/2) with t=(1/4)*exp(-10*n/sqrt(kappa)) produces 1/8, not 1/4 or 1/16.
constant_dependencies.tensorization: a^k and exp powers multiply the exponent by k, yielding k/8. The residual factor contributes exactly 1 and no dimension/constant loss.
constant_dependencies.scope: The constants 1/2,5,1/4,10,1/8 are universal on n>=3,kappa>=4; the final k dependence is explicit. No epsilon/T/delta-dependent hidden constant or additional asymptotic qualifier occurs.

required_whole_module_bridges.requirement: A_O is symmetric positive definite and the Gaussian precision formula is actually N(0,A_O^{-1}); measurable parameter dependence supports conditioned-Haar averaging. These properties must be genuine module/parent consequences, not assumed anew.

The actual Gaussian kernel and component Haar laws give actual probability mixtures P_b; p_O and p_b are measurable nonnegative densities with integral one. A chosen density representative and a.e. equivalences must preserve these laws.

The actual precision-prior averaged target is identified with the independent fixed-sign block product, plus the common normalized residual Gaussian, and transported to R^d. Ex70 cannot be asserted only for a synthetic unrelated density.

Establish integrability/finiteness of p_b, barp_b, |p_+-p_-|, |barp_+-barp_-|, overlaps and affinities. Nonnegative L1 probability densities and sqrt(uv)<=(u+v)/2 provide the source-implied control; do not promote it into a public hypothesis.
Cauchy-Schwarz in Ex69 needs square integrability of sqrt p_+ +/- sqrt p_- and the exact expansions 2 +/- 2a. Deal with all actual nonnegativity and representative conditions.

TV of actual P_b and barpi_b agrees with the S2 measurable-event supremum and half-L1 integral. If a Mathlib variation distance has another normalization or extended codomain, supply the explicit normalization and finiteness bridge.
Derive the probability overlap identity TV=1-int min; factor-two and total-mass cancellations must be justified. The pointwise min<=sqrt product step alone is not the law-level result.
Ex71 needs actual product-density/nonnegative measurable Tonelli factorization and residual total mass one, with the residual=0 omission case genuinely covered.
The actual B7 quantitative separation must feed Ex69/Eq25, and Eq25 plus Ex71 must feed Ex72. Bare tensorization does not acquire this numerical rate by itself.

Audit every declaration/import/scoped parameter in the eventual whole module and meaning-carrying project-owned definitions/parents for hidden probability, integrability, bound, witness or oracle assumptions. No new public mathematical premises are authorized for proof ingredients.
